title: "rungar providers enable"
description: "Put a provider back into placement"
---

Put a disabled provider back into placement. It lasts until the daemon restarts, which goes back to what the configuration says: set disabled there to make it last.

## Usage

```console
$ rungar providers enable NAME
```

## Global flags

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--socket string` | The daemon's socket (default `$RUNGAR_SOCKET`, or `/run/rungar/rungar.sock`). |
